mapper.select: SELECT p.payroll_id, p.store_id, p.store_staff_id, m.name AS staff_name, p.target_year_month, p.range_start_date, p.range_end_date, p.work_days_count, p.total_work_minutes, p.total_night_minutes, p.total_overtime_minutes, p.applied_hourly_wage, p.applied_transport_limit, p.base_pay, p.night_allowance, p.overtime_allowance, p.transport_allowance, p.gross_pay, p.payroll_status, p.confirmed_at, p.paid_at FROM payroll p JOIN store_staff ss ON p.store_staff_id = ss.store_staff_id JOIN member m ON ss.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.store_id = #{storeId} AND p.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} ORDER BY p.store_staff_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT payroll_daily_detail_id, payroll_id, attendance_id, work_date, applied_hourly_wage, total_break_minutes, net_work_minutes, night_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, night_overtime_minutes, base_pay, night_allowance, overtime_allowance, transport_amount FROM payroll_daily_detail WHERE payroll_id = #{payrollId} ORDER BY work_date ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE d FROM payroll_daily_detail d JOIN payroll p ON d.payroll_id = p.payroll_id WHERE d.payroll_id = #{payrollId} AND p.payroll_status = 'DRAFT'
